feed.headline: Russia Revives Demand That NATO Retrench to Secure Ukraine Deal

feed.headline: Qatar and Turkey sign defence agreement for “unified position” facing external attacks

feed.headline: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says US envoys touted the exchange as part of efforts to end the war with Russia.

feed.headline: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
feed.ai: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

feed.headline: Aide to fugitive Ukrainian ex-PM wounded in latest Moscow car bombing
feed.ai: Sergei Zavorotny, now a journalist and commentator, was previously an adviser to Ukrainian ex-prime minister Mykola Azarov.

feed.headline: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
feed.ai: The Ukrainian president says it makes sense for European leaders to be involved as Ukraine hopes to eventually join the EU.

feed.headline: Ukraine’s Starshield Access Is Being Restricted Again, Zelensky Says
feed.ai: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the system, which Ukraine uses to guide drones, was being throttled over Russian-occupied territory. SpaceX, its developer, has denied the claim.

feed.headline: One of France’s Most Popular Athletes Is Running for President
feed.ai: Centrists want alternatives to a matchup between the far right and far left in the 2027 presidential race. Enter Christine Lagarde, a former central banker — and Teddy Riner, a judo star.

feed.headline: Army Officer Accused of Trying to Spy for Russia Is Afghan War Veteran
feed.ai: The officer, who served at a NATO base in Britain, is expected to be charged in the coming days, two officials said.

feed.headline: In Moscow, Witkoff and Kushner Ask Putin to Include Europe in Peace Talks
feed.ai: In Dublin, President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine said Europeans would join the next round of talks. Russia has not confirmed that.

feed.headline: A.I. Weapons Need Data for Their Training. Ukraine Has a Lot to Offer.
feed.ai: The Ukrainian government has opened up a trove of five million battlefield videos to defense companies at home and abroad.

feed.headline: Russia sends major business delegation to Kabul for business talks with the Taliban
feed.ai: A Russian deputy prime minister led a 70-strong Russian delegation to Afghanistan, pursuing deals on transport, logistics, agriculture, and health products with the Taliban.
